entries.message: On iPhone and iPad, Start on new tab in General settings opens Crest on a new tab in your default Space, ready to search.
On iPhone the sidebar stays full screen. Turn on Allow floating sidebar in General settings to float it over the page instead.
Buttons in the floating sidebar respond to taps, and its Settings button opens Settings.
Settings on iPhone and iPad shows Crest’s real app icon, including the one you chose, in light and dark.
On iPhone and iPad, General settings shows whether Crest is your default browser instead of Unavailable when iOS limits how often Crest can check.
Edit Shortcuts and Add Provider in Search settings open right away on iPhone and iPad.
A Space’s Search with menu shows each provider’s icon, like the default search menu.
Each section in Settings has its own color, drawn from the Space templates.
